name: Can2 Termik A.S.
summary: Çan2 Termik A.S. engages in the operation of a coal fired thermal power plant in Turkey. Its power plant has an installed capacity of 340 MWm/330 MW. The company was founded in 2003 and is based in Istanbul, Turkey. As of September 10, 2013, Çan2 Termik A.S. operates as a subsidiary of Odas Elektrik Üretim Sanayi Ticaret A.S.
